title: Topic catalogue (IA spine)
description: The hand-authored taxonomy that powers yen-gov's Topic Front Door (`/t`, `/t/:topic`) and the section list inside each state hub (`/s/:state`). Topic membership of an artifact is declared HERE, not on the artifact itself — keeping `indicator.schema.json` free of IA leakage (per ADR-0022). Each topic carries its Seventh Schedule list (`state` / `union` / `concurrent` / `na`) so cross-state surfaces can render the constitutional honesty banner without per-renderer logic. Each topic points to one or more artifacts via a polymorphic `kind`+`id` reference; the renderer dispatches on `kind` so election artifacts (different schema family) coexist with indicator artifacts under the same catalogue.

x-changelog.description: Initial schema. Created for the IA reset (TODO/IA-RESET-PLACE-FIRST-WITH-TOPIC-FRONT-DOOR.md, ADR-0022). Powers state-hub section nav + the Topic Front Door routes. Polymorphic artifact references via `kind` so election artifacts (result.summary.schema.json) and indicator artifacts (indicator.schema.json) live side by side without forcing a unified data shape.

Additive: per-artifact `peer_set_default` override (artifact wins over topic default). Required because a single topic may host artifacts whose honest peer set differs — e.g. fiscal hosts both `outstanding_debt_pct_gsdp` (default `general_category`: comparing across centre-transfer asymmetry would mislead) AND `net_transfers_from_centre` (default `all`: the asymmetry IS the story). Also broadens the `peer_set_default` enum to match the new `state-tiers.json` v1.0 vocabulary: renamed `hill`→`himalayan`, `ut_with_legislature`→`ut_legislature`, `ut_without_legislature`→`ut_no_legislature`; added `special_category`, `fc_horizontal_devolution_share_quintile`, `coastal_states`, `landlocked_states`, `art_371_states`. Old enum values are no longer accepted (this would normally be a major bump under §11, but no producer artifact uses the renamed values yet — catalogue currently only references `general_category` and `all` — so the change is non-breaking in practice). See ADR-0022 §peer-sets and `docs/concepts/peer-sets.md`.

Additive: optional per-artifact `chart_type` and `dimension` fields. `chart_type` mirrors the indicator artifact's chart_type (`choropleth`/`ranked`/`stacked-trend`) so the catalogue itself can drive renderer dispatch on `/t/:topic` without the page having to peek at every indicator JSON before deciding which component to mount. `dimension` carries the categorical dimension name (e.g. `power_source`, `expenditure_head`) needed to resolve mnemonic colours through `dimensionAnchors()`. Both fields are pure UI hints — the source of truth remains the indicator artifact (per ADR-0024) — but lifting the dispatcher out of every page keeps TopicLanding/StateOverview free of per-artifact id-string switches.

Additive: `topics.items.properties.artifacts.minItems` lowered from 1 to 0 so structural placeholder topics can land before their first P.* ingestion ships any artifacts. Per TODO/20260517-canonical-long-format-pivot.md §0e.4, the 9 new top-level topics (`governance`, `schemes`, `local_govt_finance`, `work`, `judiciary`, `crime`, `education`, `amenities`, `technology`) are the structural IA skeleton: each opens with an empty `artifacts: []` array and gets populated when its dedicated P.* ingestion PR lands. The frontend renderers (TopicLanding, StateTopic) already handle `indicator_artifacts.length === 0` via a 'no indicator artifacts catalogued for this topic yet' empty state, so empty topics render cleanly without UI work. Backwards-compatible: every existing topic still has its non-empty artifacts array.

Additive: `topics.items.properties.artifacts.items.properties.id` is no longer required — it stays required for `kind: "indicator"` (where the id resolves to a concrete indicator artifact) and for `kind: "feature_collection"`, but is now optional for `kind: "election"`. Rationale: per Jony's read-aloud review of `/s/:state/t/elections`, an elections-topic artifact reference should resolve the per-state default event at render time via `defaultEventForState(state_code)` (see ADR-0023) rather than encoding a single state's cohort code in the catalogue. The pre-v1.4 shape (TN-specific `id: "AcGenMay2026"`) silently rendered as empty for every non-TN state and forced manual catalogue edits on every new election cohort. The new shape (`{ kind: "election", scope: "state" }` with no `id`) is fully state-agnostic and works for every state with an entry in `taxonomy/election_events.json`. Backwards-compatible because `required: ["kind", "id"]` becomes `required: ["kind"]` — every pre-v1.4 artifact still validates. Enforcement that `id` must be present when `kind: "indicator"` or `"feature_collection"` is added via an `oneOf` constraint on the items shape.

BREAKING (TODO/20260526-grain-over-entity-and-storage-decoupling-plan.md PR-A3c, ADR-0045 split). REMOVED: per-artifact `chart_type` and `dimension` properties. Render hints are no longer carried on the canonical topic catalogue; they live on the frontend-owned grapher catalogue at `datasets/grapher/topic_render.json` (schema `grapher-topic-render.schema.json`) and are applied at fetch time via `applyGrapherOverlay()` in `frontend/src/lib/canonical/catalogue.ts` (shipped PR-A3b). Rationale: visualization choice is a frontend concern; mixing it with the citizen-facing data taxonomy violated the storage / visualization separation (ADR-0045). Migration: every legacy artifact ref MUST have a matching row in `datasets/grapher/topic_render.json` carrying its `chart_type` + `dimension`; the PR-A3a parity test asserts coverage. Description in v1.2 (additive introduction of these fields) supersedes.

sources.description: Per CLAUDE.md §12 / ADR-0002. Topic catalogue is hand-authored taxonomy, so the canonical shape is an empty array. The commit message records the rationale and any reference materials consulted.

topics.description: Ordered list of topics. Order is the default rendering order on the `/t` index and inside each state hub. Re-ordering is a deliberate editorial act (commit it).

id.description: URL slug. Single-segment for top-level topics (`fiscal`, `elections`, `energy`). Slash-segmented allowed for sub-topics (`fiscal/transfers`).

title.description: Human display name. Shown in topnav, breadcrumb, page header. NOT a code (the catalogue user is the citizen, not the data file).

list.description: Constitutional location per the Seventh Schedule. `state` = State List subjects (police, agriculture, public health). `union` = Union List (defence, railways, foreign affairs, GST policy). `concurrent` = Concurrent List (education, criminal law, economic planning). `na` = not a Seventh Schedule subject (process topics like elections, reference catalogues). Drives the mandatory list-badge on every topic header (ADR-0022) and the Union-list ranking banner.

summary.description: One-sentence plain-language explanation of what this topic covers. Shown under the topic title on `/t/:topic`.

icon.description: Lucide icon name (e.g. `landmark`, `vote`, `zap`, `users`). Optional; renderer falls back to a generic glyph.

featured.description: When true, this topic appears in the state-hub generic hero (top-N featured topics by catalogue order). UI/UX guardrail: the hero composes ONLY from featured topics rendered via existing IndicatorChoropleth thumbnails — no bespoke chrome.

peer_set_default.description: Topic-level default peer-set filter for cross-state ranked tables. Inherited by every artifact under this topic unless that artifact overrides it via its own `peer_set_default`. Enum mirrors `state-tiers.json` tier IDs plus `all` (the no-filter superset). Adding a new tier requires (a) appending it to `state-tiers.json` and (b) broadening this enum here — minor bump on both schemas.

artifacts.description: Polymorphic references to the data artifacts this topic exposes. The renderer dispatches on `kind`. Order is the in-topic rendering order; `default: true` marks the artifact shown on `/t/:topic` before any user picks one. Empty array is permitted for structural placeholder topics whose first P.* ingestion has not yet landed — the frontend renderers (TopicLanding, StateTopic) handle the empty case with an explicit 'no indicator artifacts catalogued for this topic yet' message rather than failing.

allOf.description: v1.4: `id` is required for `kind: "indicator"` and `kind: "feature_collection"` (those reference a concrete on-disk artifact). It is optional for `kind: "election"` where the renderer resolves the per-state default event at render time via defaultEventForState(state_code).

kind.description: Which artifact family. `indicator` → indicator.schema.json; `election` → result.summary.schema.json + result.constituency.schema.json; `feature_collection` → GeoJSON+metadata for spatial-only datasets (no v1 consumers yet, reserved for Phase 7+).

id.description: For `indicator`: the indicator's `id` from its artifact (e.g. `fiscal/outstanding_debt_pct_gsdp`) — REQUIRED. For `feature_collection`: REQUIRED, names the on-disk GeoJSON+metadata bundle. For `election`: OPTIONAL since v1.4 — when omitted, the renderer resolves the per-state default event at render time via `defaultEventForState(state_code)` (see ADR-0023); when present, it pins a specific cohort code (e.g. `AcGenMay2026`) and the renderer will display only that event regardless of state. Per Jony's read-aloud review, the omitted-id shape is the right default for the elections topic because every state has a different cohort timeline and pinning one state's cohort code in the catalogue silently empties the surface for every other state.

display.description: Override display string for citizen-facing chrome. Mandatory when the underlying `id` is a code (e.g. `AcGenMay2026` → `Tamil Nadu Assembly · May 2026`).

default.description: When true, this artifact opens by default on `/t/:topic`. At most one artifact per topic SHOULD be marked default; ties are broken by array order.

featured.description: When true AND the parent topic has `featured: true`, this artifact is eligible for the state-hub generic hero.

scope.description: Geographic scope of this artifact's primary view. Drives which routes can host it: national-scope artifacts render on `/t/:topic`; state-scope artifacts render inside `/s/:state`; constituency-scope on `/s/:state/ac/:ac`. Defaults to `national` for indicators, `state` for elections.

peer_set_default.description: Per-artifact override of the topic-level `peer_set_default`. Use when an artifact in this topic has a different honest default — e.g. a transfers indicator under the fiscal topic where `all` is honest because the asymmetry IS the story, even though the topic default is `general_category`. The frontend's filter resolves: artifact value > topic value > `'all'`.

notes.description: Editorial caveats specific to this topic. Optional. Shown below the summary on `/t/:topic`.
